Sends items to you on Telegram, in your chat with the instance's bot. Link Telegram in Settings first.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `telegram.send` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Message (`message`) | text | no | `Update from your Polythought workflow` | {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}} or {{spread}}. |
| Format (`format`) | text | no | `text` | text: sent as written. html: Telegram's tags work, such as &lt;b&gt;, &lt;i&gt;, &lt;code&gt; and &lt;a href="…"&gt;; item fields are escaped. One of `text`, `html`. |
| Send (`send`) | text | no | `all` | all: one message listing every item. each: one message per item, up to 20 a run. One of `all`, `each`. |
| Silent (`silent`) | true or false | no | `false` | Deliver without a sound. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
